title: 5 Ways AI Can Strengthen Your Teaching This School Year
body_markdown:
**Key Takeaways:**


- The article highlights five practical ways educators can use AI to strengthen teaching and learning this school year:


- Create an AI toolkit, choosing the right platform for each teaching task.
- Use AI to differentiate instruction while maintaining high expectations for every student.
- Make AI a learning partner that encourages students to think, revise, and problem-solve.
- Build AI literacy by teaching students to spot bias, verify outputs, and use the technology responsibly.
- Use AI to automate routine tasks, freeing up more time to build relationships and foster student belonging.
